evidence:
Static review of all 54 criteria (1 render gate, 2 constraint gates, 42 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual). No blocking row-31 defect found. No judge run exists for this candidate (qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r11/raw-evidence-index.json is absent), so how the configured judge applies these quantifiers is unmeasured and risk stays true.

INSTANCES - quantifier wording graded over the whole collection (all acceptable). tests/scored/functional/judge.toml: cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic "The suffix must appear exactly once at each caret and nowhere else" with "if fewer than three carets receive the text"; cw_multi_caret_delete "exactly two carets ... remove exactly the last character of each" with "if only one caret is affected, if a neighbouring line or character changes"; cw_same_line_carets "directly after each of the three words ... and nowhere else" with "at fewer than three places"; cw_find_forward_backward_wrap visits all three occurrences in order and fails if either decoy line "is ever visited"; cw_replace_current "Only that middle occurrence may change; the first and last occurrences and all other text stay exact"; cw_replace_all_atomic "exactly four literal matches ... Fails if fewer or more than the four matches change"; cw_replace_self_containing_text "each of the three original occurrences must be replaced exactly once"; cw_js_semantic_coloring and cw_html_semantic_coloring "Fails if any two of those five categories look the same" / "any two of the four categories"; cw_output_before_failure_kept "any of the three markers"; cw_console_levels_in_order "any of the four markers"; cw_dynamic_code_refused "Each of the five must be refused ... Fails if any of the five"; cw_error_message_and_line "For each of these two failures"; cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line "For both unhandled cases"; cw_save_reload_restart "the same single record ... duplicated or missing"; cw_stale_save_refused "exactly one new revision ... if the saved record or its history contains any of B's values"; cw_stale_save_keeps_draft "any of B's three unsaved fields"; cw_history_restore_retry "revisions one, two and three still listed ... no fifth revision may be created". tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml: cw_shared_saved_record "if any of the three fields differs". tests/scored/polish/judge.toml: cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus "Each of these controls that the app offers and that is enabled at that moment"; cw_controls_feedback_and_labels "any of the three actions"; cw_focus_returns_to_code "after any of these five actions"; cw_narrow_width_usable "any of those five areas".

INSTANCES - "unchanged" guards, each with the legitimate side-effect carved out (all acceptable): cw_replace_current requires the current match to move on while other text stays exact; cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo and cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo "A change of quote style alone is not a failure"; cw_basic_run_output "console lines from the first Run may still be listed"; cw_preview_isolation "The app changing its own title or library for its own reasons is not a failure"; cw_mouse_selection "exactly that logical line (with or without its line break)"; cw_history_restore_retry "the restore is either refused or added on top as a later revision"; cw_last_good_recovery "The restored picture may be static"; cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus "a control the app has disabled because it has nothing to do is not counted"; tests/app_context.md:23 "the library may already hold records from earlier checks. Do not assume an empty library" keeps the single-record and duplicate guards from punishing records left by other criteria. The remaining exact-source guards (cw_caret_navigation_and_line_numbers "if any of these moves changes the source", cw_long_line_editing, cw_selection_replace_and_paste_undo, cw_format_error_keeps_draft, cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state, cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft) protect text that the operation has no legitimate reason to change.

OBSERVATIONS (non-blocking).
(N1) functional cw_stale_save_refused and cw_stale_save_keeps_draft assume tab B is untouched by A's Save: "In B, which still holds the old revision, change the title, filename and source" and "B, still on the old revision, edits the title, filename and source". B is clean at the moment A saves, whereas cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft dirties its tab before the other one saves. environment/instructions/behaviour.md:11 says "say so and keep my draft; do not load the newer revision over my work", which on a strict reading forbids any auto-load, so this is an ambiguity rather than a demonstrated defect; the golden never auto-loads (solution/app/src/app.tsx:154 shows a notice with a Load latest revision button).
(N2) polish cw_controls_feedback_and_labels "the main controls have understandable visible names ... Fails if a main control has no readable name" quantifies over a set the criterion does not enumerate, so a judge may sample; tests/app_context.md:14 lists the controls.
(N3) functional cw_js_semantic_coloring puts "the keywords function and return" in the fixture but states the bar as "the keyword" (singular); whether both keywords must be styled is left to the judge, while environment/instructions/ui.md:13 says "JavaScript keywords".
(N4) functional cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo and cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo place "One Undo must restore the exact original one-line source" after the second, no-op Format; an app that records that no-op Format as a history step needs two Undos. ui.md:15 states one Undo for a format and does not mention a repeated format.
(N5) functional cw_live_library_update only requires the changed title to appear in tab A; it does not ask whether the old title entry is gone, so a refresh that appends a duplicate entry would pass.
counterexample: No demonstrated wrong grade. Nearest cases: (N1) an app that reloads a clean, unedited tab B to A's new revision when the live library update arrives would then accept B's Save on the current revision and fail both stale-save criteria (weight 1.5 each); whether that app conforms to behaviour.md:11 is arguable. (N4) an app whose repeated no-op Format adds an undo step would fail the two format criteria (weights 2.0 and 1.5) on "if Undo or Redo need more than one step".
suggested_fix: Optional hardening, each a new candidate: in both stale-save criteria have B make its edits before A saves (as cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft already does); enumerate the controls in cw_controls_feedback_and_labels; say "both keywords" in cw_js_semantic_coloring; move the Undo and Redo step before the second Format in the two format criteria.
